title: Analysis of electrohysterogram signals for predicting obstetric outcome using machine learning methods: a scoping review
journal: BMC Pregnancy and Childbirth, Springer Nature
contribution: I have been working with Dr. Rubana Hoque Chowdhury since 2023, and this publication is a direct result of that collaboration.
